project1.title: Great Pet Care Platform - Pet Parent & Practice Management
project1.description: Contributed to the Great Pet Care platform, a Covetrus solution connecting veterinary practices and pet parents by enabling appointment scheduling, prescription management, and centralized pet health tracking. Worked on backend features for both the pet parent-facing dashboard and the platform's administrative panel, using Node.js and TypeScript. Contributed to the evolution of account management flows and pet/practice data handling, applying an AI-first development approach. Participated in architecture decisions focused on scalability and maintainability as the platform grew.

project2.title: KORA
project2.description: KORA is a next-generation Field Service Management (FSM) platform developed by Tempo, one of Brazil's leading companies in assistance, convenience, and specialized services. The platform modernizes post-purchase service operations, including furniture assembly, home appliance installation, and telecom services, connecting retailers, manufacturers, customers, and service providers. As a Senior Backend Software Engineer, contributed to the architecture, technical discovery, and development of scalable microservices responsible for scheduling, dispatching, and executing field services. Worked with API-first and event-driven architecture using Java, Spring Boot, Kafka, AWS, and Kubernetes.

project3.title: Superbid Exchange – Digital Auction Platform
project3.description: Worked within one of the largest digital auction transaction platforms in Latin America, connecting buyers and sellers across different industries and market segments. Contributed to 18 online auction applications built on a microservice architecture supporting thousands of daily active users and hundreds of concurrent bidders during peak events. Built real-time bidding APIs with NestJS, TypeScript, Socket.io and Redis powering the BidTv live auction experience, an auction management workflow system, indexing services feeding OpenSearch and ElasticSearch through RabbitMQ, a customer communication API using Kafka and MongoDB, and a Backend-for-Frontend in Spring Boot connecting the frontend to AI services. Also delivered product and event lifecycle systems with Spring Boot, Apache Camel, JPA, Oracle and Keycloak. The work reduced API response times by around 30% and reached 95% test coverage, with observability and automated CI/CD pipelines improving reliability.

project4.title: Marketplace Catalog Integration
project4.description: Built and maintained the integration systems of one of Brazil's largest fashion retail groups, Arezzo&Co and Reserva, focused on solutions that drive sales across multiple marketplaces. Developed a centralized integration for product information, pricing and stock levels, replacing manual updates with automated synchronization that improved data accuracy and enabled expansion to new sales channels. Designed integrations between internal systems and marketplace platforms such as VTEX and AnyMarket, and led the modernization of legacy services to improve performance and maintainability. Built with Node.js, TypeScript, RabbitMQ, SQL Server, CouchDB, Redis, Docker and Kubernetes on AWS.

project5.title: Brewery Automation
project5.associated: Universidade Regional Integrada do Alto Uruguai e das Missões - URI
project5.description: Developed the "Velha Guarda" mobile application, an automated control solution for craft beer production processes. The project aimed to improve productivity, safety, and efficiency by monitoring temperature throughout different brewing stages using IoT technology. The application was developed with Flutter, Dart, Firebase, and integrated with ESP8266 NodeMCU V3 using C programming and DS18B20 temperature sensors. The solution enabled recipe management, temperature monitoring, and improved control over brewing operations.

project6.title: Smart Locker
project6.description: Developed a smart locker application based on the Internet of Things (IoT) concept, controlled through a mobile application and API. The system allows locker configuration, user management, door opening control, compartment allocation, and occupancy management. A web-based management interface provides occupancy reports and access logs.
